title: 1991 AHSME Problem 18
statement: If \(S\) is the set of points \(z\) in the complex plane such that \((3+4i)z\) is a real number, then \(S\) is a

solutions.text:
Writing \(z=x+yi,\) \[ \begin{aligned} (3+4i)z &=(3x-4y)\\ &\quad +(4x+3y)i. \end{aligned} \] This is real exactly when \(4x+3y=0,\) which is the equation of a line through the origin.

Thus the correct answer is D.
hints: Set the imaginary part of \((3+4i)(x+yi)\) equal to zero
